beats.care: See a snapped wire or water near a transformer? Keep away and call 94987 94987.
beats.what: TANGEDCO listed do's and don'ts for rain: stay away from poles, transformers, fallen wires and pillar boxes.
beats.why: Rain and floodwater raise the risk of electric shocks near damaged lines.

cards.body: Don't use appliances with wet hands. Don't dry clothes on stay wires. Fit an RCCB at home to cut power if current leaks.
cards.title: Quick rules

cards.body: Avoid open ground, trees and poles. Keep away from open windows and iron grills.
cards.title: In lightning

opts: Keep people away and call the helpline
cards.q: You see a fallen wire on your street. What should you do?
cards.why: The Board says don't touch it, keep others away and wait for officials.

cards.q: Have you saved the Minnagam number?

hook: Why should you *never touch a branch* on a power line?

learn.t: Wet green branches can carry electricity, so never pull a branch off a power line yourself.

tldr: The Tamil Nadu Electricity Board has shared rain safety rules and a 24-hour helpline, 94987 94987.
watch: The advice applies through the current heavy-rain spell, expected till about October 26.
